name: Kawaba (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kawaba village emblem in white: an outlined lozenge enclosing three vertical bars.
history: Municipal flag of Kawaba, a village in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kawaba village emblem — an outlined lozenge enclosing three vertical bars
